title: Stockfish, But It Loses 500 ELO If I Play the WORST Move
summary: 'Pity Fish': Stockfish starts at 3600 and loses 500 Elo every time the player plays the engine-judged WORST move in the position. Player (white) opens g4 (worst opening move) to drop it to 3100, then g6-style pawn gifts and sacrifices pieces (e.g. hanging a bishop, leaving the queen hanging) that are the single worst moves without allowing mate-in-one. Bot drops to the low 1000s, fails to finish the player, and the player wins with a ladder mate in game 1 (73% accuracy).
rules: After each player move, if it is the worst legal move by engine evaluation, bot loses 500 Elo.
win_condition: Checkmate the bot. Video: won game 1 (ladder mate).
